messages:
Dana (Finance): BlueHorizon reported two March invoices; one shows $0, the other full amount. AP can't reconcile. Can we look?
billing-bot: Alert: invoice_generation_anomalies=2 customer_id=bluehorizon run=batch_2026_03_31 severity=high
Maya (Support): Ticket #5810: https://support.redwood.ai/t/5810 1 attached PDFs.
Lee (Billing Eng): Invoice IDs in PDFs: 2026-03-31021 (total_cents=0) and 2026-03-31021-R1 (total_cents=2123000). Both from batch_run=batch_2026_03_31_0300.
Lee (Billing Eng): Quick DB check: first invoice has 2 line items, second has 10. Capture only on -R1. Looks like partial write then retry.
Dana (Finance): Priority: void the zero invoice, regenerate canonical PDF with audit note, and prepare credit memo if needed. Customer wants corrected docs today.
Lee (Billing Eng): Running void: `./ops/void_invoice 2026-03-31021 --reason "duplicate generation"`
billing-bot: Task update: void_invoice completed invoice=2026-03-31021 actor=lee status=success ts=1887654335
Lee (Billing Eng): Regenerated PDF for 2026-03-31021-R1, added audit note: "duplicate incomplete invoice voided (batch batch_2026_03_31_0300)". Uploaded to ticket.
Oliver (Payments): Capture only on R1; no refund required. Finance, please advise on credit memo for any accounting noise.
Dana (Finance): Creating credit memo CM-2026-03-0220 and linking to account. Will post to next statement; updating ticket.
Lee (Billing Eng): Opened PR to make invoice writer idempotent by upserting on (batch_run, invoice_id) and to add a short lock during post-process: https://git.redwood.ai/r/billing/+/pr/349
Maya (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks 1 that's helpful. Please confirm in writing when ledger is reconciled."
Lee (Billing Eng): Backfill done and ledger reconciled. Note: "reserved_capacity lines backfilled for 2026-03-31021-R1; duplicate voided."
Dana (Finance): Closing loop 1 will attach RCA to ticket and confirm credit memo posting. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
